mechanisms.target_behavior: Turn multi-clue research questions into focused searches that can identify and cross-check candidates.
mechanisms.text: For multi-clue research questions, separate the clues into distinctive, independently searchable facts. Search for a candidate using one clue, then test that candidate against a different clue; avoid combining every clue into a broad query. Treat a plausible match as a lead, and state uncertainty only after using the available steps to make a meaningful verification attempt.
